note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All buildings, names and data are fictional and illustrative. Only the datum on the file tag is substituted; the route follows only the supplied mapping, and nothing about validity, competence or outcome is inferred. Long-labels-stress: coordinator decision 2026-09-26, LAW-0212 round 5: stress datum fields capped so the 1:1 lens reaches >= 0.35 of the short side (standing rule, AUTHORING item 20); fallbacks tried first: stack widths 360/250/200, natural and squared crops, every square arrangement, text down to 16.6 px, step-back to 0.64, zoom down to 1.51x (best without the cap: 0.339). Round 7 (coordinator decision 2026-09-26, LAW-0212 round 7: stress venue labels capped so the 1:1 lens reaches >= 1.5x vs rest): fallbacks tried first: tight crop (stack, clerk, file) and crop with the route fork, natural and squared crops, stack widths 360/250/200, every square arrangement, text down to 16.6 px, step-back to the 0.52 context-width limit; best before the cap: 1.31x vs rest. Length caps measured ineffective: venue names cut to baseline length gave 1.27-1.31x, mapping rows cut to baseline length 1.27-1.31x; only the second tag on one venue block (the fourth row) blocked the lens. After the cap: 1.62x vs rest at 16.6 px.
